description: This Java class 'VcapServicesStringSupplier' reads a configuration file specified either via environment variable 'VCAP_LOCATION' or directly through a provided path. It reads the file content as a single String, returning an empty Optional if the file is empty, and throws a custom error if the file cannot be read or the path is invalid.

classes.name: VcapServicesStringSupplier
classes.description: Immutable class implementing Supplier<Optional<String>> that provides the content of a VCAP services configuration file.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance based on the environment variable 'VCAP_LOCATION'.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance based on a provided Path.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the file content or empty if the file is empty.
